run_optimal_batch_size_finder: run the optimal batch size finder tool to find the best batch size for a model
run_power_scaling: run power scaling to find optimal batch size by doubling until OOM error occurs
read_images_in_batch: read images from a directory in batches for model inference testing
warmup_model: warmup a model by running demo inputs through it to stabilize performance
plot_batch_size_results: plot batch size vs seconds per image and FPS results with error bars
